## Wednesday, November 25

### Dubai Basketball vs. Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade (17:00 CET)

##### Dubai

Dubai has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Partizan on Wednesday.

- Dzanan Musa did not play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Davis Bertans last played in Round 9. He also didn't play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Davion Mintz was not on the gameday roster in Rounds 12 or 13, but he did play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Kosta Kondic last played in Round 9. His last appearance in the ABA League was on November 2.
- Klemen Prepelic has not featured in the EuroLeague so far this season. He has made four appearances in the ABA League, but he didn't feature this past weekend.
- Justin Anderson made his season debut in the ABA League on November 9. That is his only appearance of the season so far.

##### Partizan

Luca Vildoza, Ethan Thompson, Lamar Stevens and Derek Willis are all ruled out for Partizan's game at Dubai on Wednesday, the club has confirmed.

- Kevarrius Hayes returned to action in Round 13.
- Luca Vildoza (ankle) was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, nor did he play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Ethan Thompson (hip) was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, nor did he play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Lamar Stevens (calf) was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, nor did he play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Vanja Marinkovic did not play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Derek Willis has been sidelined with an [ankle injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/derek-willis-injury-further-depletes-partizan-frontcourt/) he suffered in Round 1.

### Olympiacos Piraeus vs. Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv (20:15 CET)

##### Olympiacos

Codi Miller-McIntyre, Tyler Dorsey and Jean Montero are ruled out for Olympiacos's game against Hapoel on Wednesday, the club has confirmed.

- Codi Miller-McIntyre is a late scratch for Round 14 due to illness.
- Nikola Milutinov was ruled out for Round 12 and also missed Round 13. He did not play in the Greek League this past weekend but is listed as available for Round 14.
- Tyler Dorsey last played in Round 5 after being suspended by the club.
- Jean Montero last played in Round 6. He is ruled out for six months after knee surgery, [the club announced on October 30](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/jean-montero-knee-surgery-olympiacos/).
- Tyrique Jones and Bryant Dunston did not play in the Greek League this past weekend.
- Antonis Karagiannidis has not played in the EuroLeague this season, but he has made four appearances in the Greek League.
- [John Konchar left Olympiacos](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/john-konchar-leaves-olympiacos/) on November 16.

##### Hapoel

Hapoel has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Olympiacos on Wednesday.

- Bruno Caboclo last played in Round 10. He was not on the gameday roster in Round 11 and was then ruled out in Rounds 12 and 13.
- Elijah Bryant, Tomas Satoransky, Vasilije Micic, Jacob Toppin, Zach LeDay and Dan Oturu did not play in the Israeli League this past weekend.
- Tomer Ginat last played in Round 12. He did play in the Israeli League this past weekend.
- Khadeen Carrington last played in Round 8. He was not on the gameday roster in Round 13 but did play in the Israeli League this past weekend.
- Bar Timor and Tamir Blatt have not played in the EuroLeague this season. Both have been featuring in the Israeli League.

### Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz vs. Anadolu Efes Istanbul (20:30 CET)

##### Baskonia

Baskonia has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Efes on Wednesday.

- [New signing Zach Perrin](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/zach-perrin-signs-baskonia-lleida/) has been registered and could make his Baskonia debut in Round 14.
- AJ Lawson did not play in the Spanish League this past weekend.
- New signing Rolands Smits made his debut in Round 12. He was ruled out for Round 13 due to a virus, but he did play in the Spanish League this past weekend.
- [Kenneth Faried suffered a left thigh injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/kenneth-faried-adds-to-baskonia-injury-problems/) in Round 11.
- Marcio Santos last played in Round 9.
- Tadas Sedekerskis last played in Round 7.

##### Efes

Bruno Fernando, Isaia Cordinier and Mike James are ruled out for Efes's game at Baskonia on Wednesday, the club has confirmed.

- Collin Malcolm, PJ Dozier and Fatts Russell did not play in the Turkish League this past weekend.
- [Bruno Fernando is out for 3-4 weeks](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/efess-bruno-fernando-to-miss-3-4-weeks-with-calf-injury/) after a calf injury sustained in Round 11.
- [Mike James suffered an Achilles injury in Round 3](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/mike-james-achilles-surgery-anadolu-efes/) that will see him sidelined for 7-9 months.
- Isaia Cordinier remains sidelined after undergoing surgery in May, as [was announced on May 18](https://x.com/AnadoluEfesSK/status/2056451478508712239).

### Real Madrid vs. Zalgiris Kaunas (20:45 CET)

##### Real Madrid

Real Madrid has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Zalgiris on Wednesday.

- Nick Smith and Olivier Sarr did not play in the Spanish League this past weekend.
- Eli Ndiaye made his second Real Madrid debut in Round 13.
- [Mikael Jantunen ruptured his plantar fascia](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/theo-maledon-mikael-jantunen-injuries-real-madrid/) in Round 9 and has been out ever since.
- [Facundo Campazzo is dealing with a hamstring injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/real-madrids-medical-misery-mounts-as-facundo-campazzo-goes-down/). He last played in Round 9.
- Gaby Deck (shoulder) last played in Round 3, with coach Pedro Martinez saying ahead of Round 4: "The injury is more serious than we thought." 
- [Usman Garuba suffered an Achilles injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/usman-garuba-to-undergo-surgery-after-season-ending-achilles-tear/) at last May's Final Four.

##### Zalgiris

Maodo Lo is a game-time decision while Nigel Williams-Goss (injury), Deividas Sirvydis (national team), Marek Blazevic (national team) and Dovydas Giedraitis (national team) are ruled out for Zalgiris's game at Real Madrid on Wednesday, the club has confirmed.

- Nigel Williams-Goss last played in Round 6. He is dealing with a hamstring injury.
- Dovydas Giedraitis and Kaodirichi Akobundu-Ehiogu did not play in the Lithuanian League this past weekend.
- Maodo Lo last played in Round 8. He was not on the gameday roster in Rounds 12 or 13, nor did he play in the Lithuanian League this past weekend. He has travelled to Madrid for Round 14.
- Deividas Sirvydis last played in Round 6.
- Marek Blazevic last played in Round 7. He did play in the Lithuanian League this past weekend.
## Tuesday, November 24

### Besiktas Fuzul Istanbul vs. Paris Basketball (18:00 CET)

##### Besiktas

Wenyen Gabriel and Jaylen Nowell are ruled out for Besiktas's game against Paris on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Jaylen Nowell has been ruled out since Round 11.
- Wenyen Gabriel did not play in the Greek League this past weekend. He is sidelined for Round 14.
- DaQuan Jeffries was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, but he did play in the Turkish League this past weekend and is listed as available for Round 14.
- Mady Sissoko, who had his contract frozen due to a health problem after joining in the offseason, has been registered and is available for Round 14.
- Berk Ugurlu last played in Round 9. He was listed as available for Rounds 12 and 13 but didn't make the gameday roster.

##### Paris

Paris has not yet sent an injury report for its game at Besiktas on Tuesday.

- Terry Tarpey was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, nor did he play in the French League this past weekend.
- Maozinha Pereira was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, but did he play in the French League this past weekend.
- Leo Cavaliere missed his first game of the season in Round 12 but returned to action in Round 13.
- Daulton Hommes last played in Round 8, but he has played in Paris's last three French League games.

### Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade vs. Virtus Bologna (19:00 CET)

##### Crvena Zvezda

Crvena Zvezda has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Virtus on Tuesday.

- Chris Jones, Tyson Carter and Semi Ojeleye did not play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Jared Butler was not on the gameday roster in Round 12 but returned to action in Round 13.
- Chima Moneke was not on the gameday roster in Rounds 12 or 13 but did play in the ABA League this past weekend.
- Johnathan Motley missed Rounds 11 and 12 due to flu. He also didn't play in Round 13 but did feature in the ABA League this past weekend.
- [Stefan Miljenovic](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/zvezdas-stefan-miljenovic-out-after-ankle-surgery/) had ankle surgery before Round 11. He was also ruled out for Round 12 and didn't play in Round 13, nor in the ABA League this past weekend.

##### Virtus

Bobi Klintman and Davide Casarin are ruled out for Virtus's game at Crvena Zvezda on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Bobi Klintman played in Round 13 and in the Italian League this past weekend but is sidelined for Round 14.
- [New signing Awudu Abass](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/awudu-abass-returns-virtus-bologna/) has been registered and could make his second Virtus debut in Round 14.
- [New signing Achille Lonati](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/achille-lonati-signs-virtus-bologna-st-bonaventure/) has been registered and could make his Virtus debut in Round 14.
- Daniel Hackett, Kessler Edwards, Derrick Alston and Kevin Kokila did not play in the Italian League this past weekend, but they are all listed as available for Round 14.
- Davide Casarin has been ruled out since Round 11.

### FC Bayern Munich vs. Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv (20:00 CET)

##### Bayern

Bayern has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Maccabi on Tuesday.

- Austin Wiley was a game-time decision for Round 12 and while he was named on the gameday roster, he did not play. He wasn't on the gameday roster in Round 13, but he did feature in the German League this past weekend.
- Miles Norris was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, nor did he feature in the German League this past weekend.
- Oscar da Silva did not play in the German League this past weekend due to illness. 
- Justus Hollatz, who was ruled out for Round 12, returned to action in Round 13 but then did not play in the German League this past weekend.

##### Maccabi

Maccabi has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Dubai on Thursday.

- Kamar Baldwin, Oshae Brissett, Armando Bacot and Daniel Theis did not play in the Israeli League this past weekend.
- Will Rayman was not on the gameday roster in Rounds 12 or 13, but he did play in the Israeli League this past weekend.
- Iffe Lundberg will be out until the spring after undergoing knee surgery.

### Valencia Basket vs. Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens (20:30 CET)

##### Valencia

Jasiel Rivero and Nate Reuvers are ruled out for Valencia's game against Panathinaikos on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Nate Reuvers (foot) last played in Round 7.
- Jasiel Rivero did not play in the Spanish League this past weekend. He is sidelined for Round 14.
- Nikola Mirotic returned to action in Round 13.
- Omari Moore was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, but he did play in the Spanish League this past weekend.

##### Panathinaikos

Kostas Sloukas and Lefteris Mantzoukas are ruled out for Panathinaikos's game at Valencia on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Lefteris Mantzoukas has been ruled out for the last three rounds. He last played in Round 6.
- Jerian Grant returned to action in Round 13. He did not play in the Greek League this past weekend.
- Moustapha Fall was not on the gameday roster in Round 13. He last stepped onto the floor in Round 9.
- Along with Grant, Kostas Sloukas, Nigel Hayes-Davis and Isaac Bonga did not play in the Greek League this past weekend.
- Nikos Rogkavopoulos and Panagiotis Kalaitzakis were not on the gameday roster in Round 13, but they did play in the Greek League this past weekend.
- Dimitris Moraitis last played in Round 6. He played in the Greek League this past weekend.

### LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne vs. Armani Olimpia Milan (20:45 CET)

##### ASVEL

ASVEL has not yet sent an injury report for its game against Milan on Tuesday.

- TyTy Washington did not play in the French League this past weekend.
- Hugo Besson was not on the gameday roster in Round 13, but he did play in the French League this past weekend.
- Joel Bolomboy suffered a broken nose in Round 11. He hasn't played since.
- Myles Cale has left the club, [ASVEL announced on November 23](https://x.com/LDLCASVEL/status/2124877010887455028).
- Yves Pons last played in Round 10.

##### Milan

Leandro Bolmaro is a game-time decision while Alec Peters and Devin Booker are ruled out for Milan's game at ASVEL on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Devin Booker suffered a torn tendon in his right thigh in Round 9 and has been out ever since.
- Leandro Bolmaro (adductor) did not play in the Italian League this past weekend.
- Alec Peters (psoas tear) did not play in the Italian League this past weekend and is sidelined for Round 14. He will be reevaluated in two weeks' time.

### FC Barcelona vs. Fenerbahce Tarfin Istanbul (21:00 CET)

##### Barcelona

Killian Hayes and Tyrese Martin are questionable while Josh Nebo, Umoja Gibson, Tosan Evbuomwan, Kevin Punter and Yoan Makoundou are ruled out for Barcelona's game against Fenerbahce on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- [New signing Killian Hayes](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/killian-hayes-signing-barcelona/) has been registered and could make his Barcelona debut in Round 14.
- Josh Nebo is out for 3-4 months with a knee injury, [Barcelona announced on November 22](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelonas-josh-nebo-to-miss-3-4-months-with-knee-injury/).
- Tyrese Martin did not play in the Spanish League this past weekend.
- Umoja Gibson suffered an injury in Round 11 and is out for three weeks, [Barcelona announced on November 15](https://x.com/FCBbasket/status/2121985074568519821).
- [Kevin Punter](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) suffered a sprain to his left ankle and is expected to be out until the end of December.
- [Tosan Evbuomwan](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has a tear in the oblique muscle of his abdominal wall and is expected to be out until early December.
- Yoan Makoundou has not played so far this season as he recovers from a knee injury.

##### Fenerbahce

Trent Forrest, Nicolo Melli and Braxton Key are ruled out for Fenerbahce's game at Barcelona on Tuesday, the club has confirmed.

- Trent Forrest is a late scratch for Round 14.
- [Nicolo Melli underwent surgery on his left knee](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/nicolo-melli-braxton-key-surgery-fenerbahce/) to repair a torn meniscus ahead of Round 12.
- [Braxton Key had an operation on a fractured finger](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/nicolo-melli-braxton-key-surgery-fenerbahce/) on his right hand ahead of Round 12.
- Onuralp Bitim was not on the gameday roster in Round 12. He was ruled out in Round 13 but did feature in the Turkish League this past weekend.
- Ignas Sargiunas and Marcus Bingham did not play in the Turkish League this past weekend.
